comparison.objective: Raise a care-bed side rail until its spring latch catches.
comparison.physical_skill: Swing a gravity-loaded rail through an arc and push a ramped latch tooth into its keeper before releasing.
comparison.success_condition: Rail remains at the upright position with the latch caught and hands clear for one second; raising then dropping the rail permanently fails.
comparison.reason: A single contact-driven latch operation differs from selecting an opening angle, preserving it during jam-nut tightening, and confirming it through repeated cycles.
